Huge is a global digital experience, design, and technology company that helps organizations create and improve digital products, services, and customer experiences. Its work combines product strategy, experience design, software engineering, data, and emerging technologies to solve complex business challenges. The company collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to deliver digital platforms and technology-driven solutions for clients across multiple industries.

The ideal candidate has strong programming skills, an understanding of modern software architecture, and the ability to work collaboratively with designers, product managers, and other engineers.

In this role, you will help translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions, improve application performance, and deliver reliable software experiences that meet client and user needs.

* Design, develop, and maintain software applications and digital platforms.

* Apply software development best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to engineering workflows.
* Support continuous improvement through testing, monitoring, and user feedback.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C#.
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and application architecture.
* Experience using Git and collaborative development tools.
* Knowledge of debugging, testing, and software development life cycles.
* Understanding of web technologies and modern application frameworks.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and manage competing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience developing and maintaining production software applications.
* Familiarity with React, Node.js, cloud services, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and application monitoring.
* Understanding of Agile development methodologies.

**This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire.**

**As a Software Developer III**, you will be responsible for the designs, codes, and develops new financial applications or web based systems and/or modifies existing core financial application systems and web based systems.

* **Member-Focused Mission**: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
* **Flexible Schedule Options**
* **Career Growth**: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

* Responds to end user trouble calls to resolve routine application software problems or assist with hardware issues remotely when possible. Routes calls as needs for more non-routine questions. Track tickets in an incident management system to properly identify problem and resolution for a shared knowledge base or escalate and assign as needed for higher level support.
* Designs, develops, tests, and integrates moderately complex internal and external core and web applications, services, and sites, including maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting in order to fulfill business needs. Assists in determining cost and schedule of various software projects using current and proven software engineering
* Provides tier III technical support for staff on internal and external core and web applications and systems.

$113,900.00 - $120,628.00

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform Lead (Horizon AI)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**Data Platform Lead**
----------------------

Horizon AI is building the operating system for how organizations run themselves. The first step is autonomous data centers. A fleet of AI agents senses the state of STN’s GPU infrastructure, reasons about what it finds, and increasingly acts on it. This is running in production against real fleet data, not a prototype. Agents already take action where the risk is bounded and the outcome is verifiable. Everything riskier arrives as a recommendation for a human, and the work is moving decisions from the second category into the first, one class at a time, on evidence rather than optimism.

Data centers are the proving ground, not the destination. We start here because infrastructure is measurable and unforgiving: an agent is either right, or the fleet tells you it was wrong. What we build here generalizes, and we know where it goes next.

**Level:** Principal (MTS 5) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer

**The role.** Build the data foundation the platform reasons over. Today our agents assemble a picture of the fleet by querying several separate systems, and we cannot prove wider autonomy because we do not systematically capture how humans decide. You fix both.

**The problems you inherit**

* Fleet state is scattered across a relational store, a DCIM system, and multiple time-series and monitoring systems. Each has its own query path. There is no unified model. - No decision-capture pipeline exists. We record what agents did, but not what operators saw, concluded, and chose. That record is the evidence base for granting agents wider autonomy.
* Our retrieval pipeline is document-oriented rather than fleet-state-oriented.
* We consume telemetry from systems other teams operate, where retention and granularity are tuned for dashboards rather than for learning from history.

**You will**

* Design and build the fleet knowledge model: assets, topology, configuration, and current state, queryable by an agent in one call rather than five
* Build the decision-capture pipeline, and instrument the operator workflow so we accumulate labelled human decisions from day one
* Own the data access layer that abstracts telemetry sources, so we can keep consuming today and build our own collection if that stops scaling
* Negotiate our requirements with the teams who own the telemetry: signals, granularity, retention, raw event access
* Own the scale path, including vector index behaviour and the analytics separation a growing schema will eventually need

**You have**

* Strong data modelling judgment, particularly modelling physical or infrastructure domains as something queryable
* Experience with time-series and event data at scale, including cardinality and retention trade-offs
* Depth in PostgreSQL, including vector search, and comfort with a large evolving schema - Enough infrastructure literacy to know what a fleet actually is: nodes, GPUs, fabric, schedulers, power. Familiarity with DCIM tooling is a strong plus
* A bias toward shipping a usable model early over designing a complete one

**Nice to have:** GPU fleet or HPC exposure, DCGM, Slurm, entity resolution across inconsistent sources

jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.***

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the team:**

The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem. The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.

**What you'll do:**

* We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency.
* It's not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.
* We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.
* In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.
* Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.

**What you'll need to succeed:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
* Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well-documented, and well-tested

* 2+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services
* Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming

* C++ development experience
* Experience with Kubernetes

* Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Reliability Platform
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts. Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience.

Reliability Platform's long-term vision is to operationalize a flywheel of reliability data and insights in order to continually raise the bar for our global engineering organization.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Software Engineer on the Reliability Platform team, you'll help design, build, and operate software and infrastructure that deliver on the team's mission and vision described above in collaboration with expert peers across the Infrastructure and Product organizations. You will work on mission-critical back-end services and pipelines, complex orchestration workflows, self-service platform capabilities and agentic intelligence.

We see and believe in the promise of agentic AI to radically reshape and supercharge how we serve our users and stakeholders while remaining pragmatic and committed to delivering positive business-value outcomes as the ultimate goal.

Some examples of what the Reliability Platform team does:

* Own and drive unification of incident management process and tooling globally across all DoorDash-owned brands
* Create the framework that measures SLO compliance and quality across tens of thousands of endpoints and derive the programmatic insights that ensure engineering teams are informed and accountable for the quality of their products
* Build the internal SRE Agent used in incidents which supports team/domain-specific knowledge bases and obviates legacy runbooks
* Set up MCP for agentic use of Reliability Platform data + tools and enable other Core Infra teams to follow suit

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Deliver Innovative Capabilities**: You don't want to 'turn the crank' somewhere, but you want to contribute to strategic thinking and help us drive meaningful continuous improvement.
* **Be Customer Obsessed:** We want to learn from our internal customers to ensure we are solving the right challenges, and also share our perspective to influence in areas of expertise
* **Hold a High Quality Bar:** We need to lead by example in how we develop, build, test and ship our products to show that we can work at high velocity without sacrificing quality outcomes.
* **Automate Everything:** Your first instinct is to ask how toil can be obviated or, failing that, automated away from humans.
* **Shape the Future of Operations**: Experiment with agentic AI workflows that can propose, validate, and safely execute production changes — moving DoorDash toward proactive, self-healing systems in step with industry first movers.

**We're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------

  

* Platform Engineering Mindset: You think in terms of APIs, abstractions, and workflows — you enjoy building systems that other engineers depend on every day.
* Proven Experience: You have 2+ years of experience in an infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering role, showing you can deliver and maintain complex systems.
* Backend Development Skills: You're fluent in Go (or a similar language) and can design and deliver mission-critical services that are scalable, resilient, performant, and efficient.
* Cloud/Infra Expertise: You're comfortable with AWS primitives, security best practices, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.
* SRE Experience: You understand concepts like SLOs, error budgets, and incident response though this is a platform development team, not an SRE/oncall team.
* AI Alignment: You embrace the use of AI tools to be a more productive and capable engineer. This applies to coding, planning, supporting peers, and everything you do.
* Curiosity About the Future: You're excited about automation and agentic, AI-assisted operations and want to help shape how engineers interact with production systems.

**About DoorDash**

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment & Support
jobs.description:
**About Destro AI**

Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart.

Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators.

**About The Role**

We're hiring a Robotics Forward Deployed Engineer, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function.

**Schedule Expectations**

This is a field deployment role, not a standard office-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours.

* Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go-lives are frequently scheduled during off-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations.
* This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on-site.
* Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice.
* Candidates seeking a fixed 9-to-5, Monday-through-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit.

**What You'll Do**

*Software*

* Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities.
* Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable.
* Translate field learnings into production-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites.

*Field Deployment*

* Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams.
* Own production issues end-to-end during launch and stabilization, including off-hours incidents.
* Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes.

*Systems and Infrastructure*

* Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro-managed servers and edge devices.
* Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate-based service security.
* Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards.

**Who You Are**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone.
* Comfortable being paged off-hours and traveling on short notice.
* Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high-pressure environments without a fully specified solution.
* Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership.

**Technical Skills**

*Required*

* Strong Python or C++, with the ability to write maintainable, production-grade code.
* Hands-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images.
* Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls.
* Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates.
* Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT).
* Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows.

*Strongly Preferred*

* Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management.
* Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP.
* Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time-series databases.
* WMS/WES/ERP integration experience.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing.
* Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril's Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) team, we're pushing the boundaries of aerial drone technology. We're the driving force behind groundbreaking products like Ghost, Anvil, Bolt, and Altius, taking them from concept to fully operational systems that are reshaping the landscape of defense and security. Our team tackles the entire spectrum of small drone development (Group 1-3), from the drones themselves to the critical equipment needed for testing, deployment, and operation. We thrive on solving complex challenges, collaborating with specialist teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions for our customers. In TRS, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working with state-of-the-art technology and pushing the limits of what autonomous systems can achieve. If you're passionate about creating transformative technology and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of defense capabilities, we want to hear from you. Join us in our quest to develop game-changing aerial systems that are redefining what's possible in tactical reconnaissance and strike operations.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives.

**Lead AI Engineer**

**The details**

* Location: Sweet James Headquarters (Newport Beach, CA), on-site

* Team: Technology

* Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

* Compensation: $200,000 to $250,000 base salary, depending on experience

**The role**

Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI-forward experience for every client-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in-house, and you will be one of the people building them.

Sweet James is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to own the direction, standards, and health of the AI platform and to lead the engineers who build it. This is a player-coach seat for a staff-level engineer ready to manage: You will set the architecture, turn the roadmap into a build plan the team can execute, and remain hands-on in the code.

You will report to the Chief Technology Officer and own how the platform is built and run. The distinction from our Senior AI Engineer seat is scope: Senior engineers own features end to end; you own the system they fit into and the people who build it.

**Responsibilities**

* Direction: Own the architecture of the AI platform (e.g., document intake and filing, fact extraction, case search, the internal assistant and its agents, voice agents) and review every major design before it is built. The roadmap is set by the Chief Technology Officer and product leadership; you decide how it gets built.

* Standards: Define how the team ships, including code review, testing, and the evaluation sets every AI feature must clear before release.

* Platform health: Own uptime, monitoring, incident response, and access controls across the platform, and ensure no system depends on one person.

* People and capacity: Allocate the team's capacity against the priorities the Chief Technology Officer sets, make the trade-offs when demand exceeds it, and coach, review, and hire the engineers who carry the work.

* Delivery: Ship production code yourself every week.

* Business partnership: Decide with attorneys, case managers, and operations leaders which work is worth automating next, and report results in hours returned, error rates, and adoption.

* Data governance: Set the rules for least-privilege access, audit trails, and which client and medical data may reach which model.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Experience: 8+ years building production software, with a track record as the technical lead on systems other engineers depended on.

* Leadership: Mentoring, design review, and ownership of a team's output; formal people management is welcome but not required.

* LLM craft: Systems shipped to real users spanning prompt and tool design, retrieval, structured extraction, evaluation, and cost and latency tuning.

* Stack: Strong Python and TypeScript/Node, production SQL in Postgres, Docker, containerized cloud services (Azure preferred), CI/CD, and monitoring.

* Operations: Ownership of uptime, including on-call, incident reviews, and rollbacks.

* Communication: Clear design docs, runbooks, and plain-language explanations for non-engineers.

**Preferred:**

* Models and tooling: Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs at production scale; agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol; vector search (e.g., pgvector); self-hosted or open-weight models (e.g., vLLM, Baseten).

* Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n.

* Salesforce: The data model and APIs; Litify a plus.

* Voice: Voice AI and telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom).

* Industry: Legal, insurance, or healthcare.

Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law.

Stay safe: We will never ask for payment or banking information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Lead applied research in one or more Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — and carry the results into the product. You will frame the problem, survey what already exists, build prototypes that test a real hypothesis, and measure honestly enough to act on the answer. The role exists because our advantage comes from turning advanced research into dependable mission capability.

**Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Frame research problems drawn from real product and mission gaps, define what a result must show to be worth productizing, and survey existing work before building.
* Build prototypes that isolate the question being asked, at the fidelity the question actually requires.
* Run rigorous experiments — baselines, ablations, held-out evaluation, and honest error analysis — with methodology another engineer can reproduce.
* Build and maintain the datasets and evaluation harnesses your area depends on, including cases that capture known failure modes.
* Report results clearly, negative results included, and make a defensible recommendation to continue, pivot, or stop.
* Transition validated results into production alongside product engineers, staying involved through the handoff rather than delivering a notebook.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications, open-source releases, and academic collaborations, and advise Orbis on what in the field is worth adopting.
* Travel up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 3+ years of applied research or research-engineering experience, or an M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with equivalent applied work
* Strong Python engineering skills, producing research code another engineer can read, run, and build on
* Demonstrated experience designing and running experiments that produced an actionable conclusion, with methodology you can defend
* Depth in at least one Orbis AI focus area: agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, or high-performance analytics
* Working knowledge of modern LLM and retrieval methods and their practical limitations
* Clear technical writing that makes a result legible to engineers and non-specialist stakeholders alike
* Willingness to travel up to 20%

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Publication record, open-source contributions, or academic collaborations in a relevant area
* Experience carrying a research result all the way into a production system
* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, reasoning systems, or information extraction
* Experience with agent architectures, planning, or multi-agent coordination
* Experience with model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation at scale
* Experience with performance engineering on data-intensive or analytical workloads
* Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
* Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
* **Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Orbis Benefits**

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

**Orbis Locations**

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

  

*Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,*

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer – Enterprise AI Agents
jobs.description:
**Terraform and AWS networking are your home ground? Build infrastructure that has no off-the-shelf answer yet.**

A ~30-person AI startup in New York, Series A and backed by leading investors, builds AI agents for the teams that run some of the world's largest enterprise software systems. These systems are critical, old and hard to work with, and today's AI coding tools can't reach them. Customers already use the platform to make those teams several times more productive. The founders combine frontier AI engineering with deep domain expertise.

They're hiring **3 infrastructure engineers**.

**What you'll own**

* Core platform infrastructure as code, mostly AWS with Terraform: reliable, scalable and secure
* The building blocks underneath the agents: large-scale code search, auth, sandboxes, tool use and orchestration
* Automated deployments across many customer AWS accounts, with RBAC, SSO, audit and data residency, in the cloud and on-premise
* Connectivity into customer environments (VPNs, firewall rules, routing), working with their IT teams
* For one seat: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance
* Large pieces of the platform within your first two months, and making them better, not just maintaining them

**Must-haves**

* You've written and run Terraform in production yourself
* Deep AWS knowledge, networking included (VPCs, VPNs, IAM, routing)
* Evidence of exceptional ability, such as top grades or programming-contest results (Codeforces and the like)
* At least 3 years of engineering experience
* You solve new, unfamiliar problems from first principles, without needing fully defined tickets
* Working from the New York office every weekday, 9-9-5

**Bonus points**

* Deployments across many AWS accounts, or on-premise installs at large enterprises
* CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions); Python, Go, JavaScript or React
* Background in security or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001
* Strong opinions on AI-native development, and your own tooled workflow

**What's in it for you**

* $200k–$400k base + 0.1–0.5% equity
* Greenfield infrastructure at a well-funded company with real enterprise customers
* Full health, dental and vision coverage

**Good to know**

* Full-time, on-site in New York, 9-9-5
* Visa transfers are welcome; new visa sponsorship is considered per candidate, so please share your exact status
Process: first conversation with a co-founder two technical interviews with the founding engineers a paid trial of 1–3 days references* offer

**When you apply, please include**

* Your CV (PDF), your **LinkedIn URL**, and GitHub if you have one
* AWS infrastructure you built and ran with Terraform, and how big it was
* Where you studied, your degree, and any contest results
* Your current location, and confirmation that working from the New York office every weekday works for you
* Your visa or citizenship status, and if you'll need sponsorship
* Your base salary expectation, your notice period, and any other interview processes you're in

Does this sound like you? Apply now. If you're a match, we'll be in touch within 3 working days.

jobs.title: Cloud & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Howmet Engines Shared Services is seeking a Cloud and AI Engineer to join a close, cross-functional team supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud services, and the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence across the business. This role designs, builds, supports, and continuously improves Azure-based data, AI, and integration capabilities that enable secure, reliable, and scalable business and manufacturing solutions.

The successful candidate will combine cloud engineering, data and AI platform experience, and strong operational discipline. They will work with infrastructure, security, application, data, and manufacturing teams to develop and operationalize AI and machine-learning solutions, including their integration with process-control environments. The role requires sound judgement, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to translate business and operational requirements into supportable technical solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, administer, and support Azure cloud services used for AI, data, and business applications, including compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and monitoring capabilities.
* Build and support machine-learning development and deployment workflows using Azure Machine Learning, including data preparation, experiment tracking, model registration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Configure and support Azure AI Foundry capabilities to enable governed development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of generative-AI and other AI solutions.
* Assist data scientists, application teams, and business stakeholders in operationalizing models for reliable integration with process-control environments, ensuring solutions are appropriately tested, monitored, documented, and supportable.
* Develop and maintain secure integration patterns between cloud-based AI services, enterprise applications, data platforms, and manufacturing or operational technology environments.
* Apply security, identity, networking, configuration, logging, and data-protection controls in accordance with established company standards and architecture.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, data, application, and manufacturing teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities, incidents, configuration issues, and operational risks.
* Monitor AI and cloud services for availability, performance, cost, model quality, drift, and operational health; investigate and resolve issues in a timely manner.

* Automate repeatable cloud, AI, deployment, and operational activities using scripting and infrastructure-as-code practices.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

At **Bandwidth**, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach. The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, *the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.* And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? **#JoinTheBand**

**What We Are Looking For:**

As an **Applied AI Engineer** on the Corporate IT Engineering team, you'll identify where AI can create real leverage across our internal systems and operations, and build it. You'll work inside a team that owns a broad and complex infrastructure footprint, embedding AI into the platforms and workflows that keep Bandwidth running. This is an infrastructure and systems role with a deep AI focus.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own and extend existing AI platforms and tooling, improving reliability, expanding capabilities, and integrating them more deeply with internal systems.
* Architect and build internal API layers and shared services that allow AI workflows and internal applications to publish, version, and retrieve outputs across the engineering ecosystem.
* Identify and build AI-powered tooling that creates leverage across the Corporate IT Engineering stack, including infrastructure, identity, monitoring, and automation platforms.
* Develop and iterate on proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how AI can augment or automate internal workflows; from anomaly detection in infrastructure logs to AI-assisted documentation and IT troubleshooting.
* Containerize and orchestrate AI workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring reliable and reproducible deployments across environments.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Ansible, following infrastructure-as-code best practices.
* Establish AI development patterns and best practices across the Corporate IT Engineering organization, helping teams adopt AI capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Stay current with the evolving AI and MLOps landscape and bring relevant advancements back to the team.

**What You Need:**

### **AI & Application Development**

* Hands-on experience owning or extending LLM-powered platforms, including RAG pipeline development, prompt engineering, and integrating LLM APIs into production internal systems.
* Expert-level knowledge of AI infrastructure, including model serving, inference optimization, GPU/CPU resource management, and MLOps pipelines.
* Experience designing and building internal API layers or shared platform services that multiple teams and systems publish to and consume from.
* Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript for building integrations, scripts, and lightweight internal services.
* Experience working with REST APIs and building integrations across a diverse internal tooling ecosystem.

### **Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Strong AWS experience: required proficiency in core services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC) and experience architecting and operating production workloads on AWS.

* An experimental mindset: comfortable inheriting imperfect systems, iterating quickly, and improving as you go.

* Work that connects directly to your passion

* Your current location, and confirmation that on-site San Francisco works for you
* Your visa or citizenship status, and if you'll need sponsorship
* Your base salary expectation, your notice period, and any other interview processes you're in

Does this sound like you? Apply now. If you're a match, we'll be in touch within 3 working days.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI (Entry-Level)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Support applied research across the Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — working alongside senior research engineers on questions with real product stakes. You will reproduce baselines, build evaluation datasets and harnesses, run experiments, and write up what actually happened. This role exists to bring strong early-career engineers into applied AI research and grow them toward owning a research area.

**Travel**: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Reproduce baselines and published methods, and document precisely where your results diverge from what was reported.
* Build and maintain evaluation datasets and harnesses, including cases that capture known failure modes.
* Run experiments designed with senior research engineers, keeping records complete enough that someone else can rerun them.
* Perform error analysis — characterize what the system got wrong and why, and report it without smoothing it over.
* Implement well-scoped prototype components with design direction and code review from senior engineers.
* Summarize relevant literature and open-source work, and explain how it bears on the question at hand.
* Write up results, negative results included, and present them in team research reviews.
* Travel occasionally, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 0-2 years of professional experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated ability
* Solid programming fundamentals in Python, with code you can walk us through and defend
* Working understanding of machine learning and LLM fundamentals — evaluation basics, prompting, embeddings, and retrieval — from coursework, projects, internships, or professional work
* Ability to read a technical paper and explain what it claims, how it was evaluated, and where it might not hold
* Intellectual honesty about results, including the ones that undercut a hypothesis you liked
* Willingness to travel occasionally, up to 10%

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Research experience from a thesis, lab, internship, or open-source project
* Hands-on project experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, or fine-tuning
* Exposure to graph databases, ontologies, or information extraction
* Experience with experiment tracking and evaluation tooling such as notebooks, dataset construction, or scoring pipelines
* Exposure to containerized environments (Docker) and cloud or GPU compute
* Interest in OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
* Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
* **Travel**: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

**Orbis Benefits**

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

**Orbis Locations**

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

  

*Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,*

*qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.*

*Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every j

jobs.title: Data Engineer (SR)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes enterprise data solutions that enable data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across TMRS. This role is responsible for the architecture and implementation of data pipelines, data repositories, and reporting platforms; applies data engineering and data governance standards; and leads the integration and operationalization of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities. Working within the IS Department, this role partners closely with business stakeholders and Executive Leadership to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and high-quality data solutions that support organizational objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions using modern SaaS and PaaS platforms.
* Design and maintain data models, including dimensional and semantic models, that make enterprise data usable and consistent across reporting and analytics.
* Develop and tune complex queries and transformations using SQL, PL/SQL, T-SQL, and Python to support ETL and ELT processes.
* Create and maintain reliable data repositories, ensuring accurate data lineage, documented definitions, and data integrity across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Integrate data from systems of record using established data modeling standards
* Establish automated data quality monitoring, reconciliation, and pipeline observability; define and report on data quality measures.
* Lead enterprise AI and machine learning initiatives, including model integration and operationalization.
* Establish and maintain end-to-end model lifecycle management processes, including version control, validation and approval, deployment standards, continuous performance monitoring for drift and accuracy, and scheduled periodic reviews with documented outcomes.

Description

**Contract Type:** Contractor Full-Time / Enterprise Project Engagement (Outsourced via Xenon7)

About Xenon7

*Where elite tech talent meets world-class opportunities! At Xenon7, we work with leading enterprise clients and innovative startups on high-impact projects across Data, AI, Cloud, and Software Engineering. Our expertise in AI solution architecture and specialized technical talent allows us to partner with enterprise leaders on transformative initiatives, driving innovation and business growth.*

Role purpose

Lead the development and application of digital twins to improve clinical trial design and support evidence-based clinical development decisions. The role prioritizes digital-twin, simulation, and AI/ML expertise, supported by clinical-development experience and close partnership with trial-design experts.

Position overview

You will join a multidisciplinary clinical development environment and partner with clinical scientists, physicians, biostatisticians, pharmacometricians, biomarker experts, data scientists, data engineers, and other stakeholders. You will translate clinical development questions into quantitative strategies and deliver interpretable analyses that inform protocol design, patient selection, endpoint strategy, dosing, operational planning, and decision-making under uncertainty.

The role prioritizes digital twins as the primary capability for simulating patients, disease trajectories, treatment response, and clinical trials. The successful candidate will bring strong digital-twin, simulation, and AI/ML expertise, along with sufficient clinical-development knowledge to work effectively with trial teams. Deeper trial-design expertise can be developed through close collaboration with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, and pharmacometricians.

Key responsibilitiesDigital-twin development and validation

* Lead the design, development, and evaluation of digital twins of patients, disease trajectories, treatment response, or clinical trials using clinical trial and relevant external data.
* Combine mechanistic, statistical, causal, and machine learning approaches to create fit-for-purpose digital twins that can be simulated under alternative populations, interventions, dosing strategies, endpoints, or trial designs.
* Define use cases and contexts of use with clinical and quantitative experts so each digital twin addresses a specific trial-design or development decision.
* Assess calibration, validation, robustness, transportability, uncertainty, and practical relevance using appropriate internal and external evaluation strategies.
* Develop reproducible workflows and reusable digital-twin components that can be applied across programs or therapeutic areas.

Clinical trial design and quantitative decision support

* Partner with trial teams to frame development questions and evaluate design options, including target populations, eligibility criteria, enrichment strategies, comparators, endpoints, visit schedules, dosing strategies, and operational tradeoffs.
* Use digital twins and complementary simulation methods to compare plausible scenarios, characterize uncertainty, and support model-informed decision-making.
* Work closely with statisticians and pharmacometricians so analyses complement established trial-design methods and align with clinical and regulatory objectives.
* Communicate assumptions, limitations, and decision-relevant insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data integration and scientific collaboration

* Analyze and integrate clinical trial data and, where relevant, biomarkers, imaging, digital health data, omics, patient-reported outcomes, and real-world data.
* Partner with data engineering and platform teams to create analysis-ready datasets, data-quality checks, lineage, and reproducible pipelines.
* Contribute to scientific documentation, presentations, publications, and responsible adoption of digital-twin methods across clinical development.

Model quality and responsible use

* Define the intended use, decision context, success criteria, and limitations of each model before development.
* Ensure models are interpretable, auditable, reproducible, and supported by evidence appropriate to their intended use.
* Apply appropriate governance, privacy, security, and scientific-review requirements for clinical data and analytical outputs.
* Clearly distinguish exploratory analyses from validated decision-support evidence and avoid overclaiming model capability.

 **Requirements**

* PhD in data science, statistics, biostatistics, pharmacometrics, computer science, biomedical informatics, engineering, mathematics, operations research, or a related quantitative field.
* Demonstrated experience developing digital twins, virtual patients, disease-progression models, clinical trial simulations, synthetic controls, or closely related computational models.
* Strong experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, causal inference, or simulation to biomedical, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other complex scientific data.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, or a comparable analytical language, with experience using version-controlled and reproducible workflows.
* Sufficient clinical-development knowledge to frame relevant questions and collaborate effectively with clinical and quantitative trial experts.
* Ability and interest to deepen clinical trial-design knowledge through partnership with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, and pharmacometricians.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional scientific collaboration.

Preferred qualifications

* Strongly preferred: experience supporting clinical trial design, protocol development, clinical development strategy, model-informed drug development, or regulatory-facing qua

**Position Summary:**

The DoW Data Scientist – War Data Platform is a mission‑focused technical role responsible for developing advanced data science, analytics, and data‑engineering solutions within the Department of Defense War Data Platform ecosystem. The role requires deep expertise integrating and analyzing large‑scale operational, logistical, readiness, and force‑design data using modern tools such as Foundry and Advana.

The Data Scientist supports warfighter‑focused decision‑making by building predictive models, optimizing pipelines, and delivering high‑quality analytics products that directly inform strategy, resource allocation, and senior‑leader decisions. This position is hybrid with on‑site engagement depending on mission needs.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* **War Data Platform / Mission Analytics**
  + Develop data science solutions directly within the War Data Platform, enabling large‑scale analysis of operational, logistics, personnel, and readiness datasets.
  + Design workflows and analytics that fuse multi‑domain data to support warfighter decisions.
  + Implement repeatable modeling, automation, and analytic pipelines optimized for secure DoD environments.
* **Foundry / Advana Development**
  + Build and maintain high‑quality data pipelines in Foundry, including transforms, ontology development, and code‑workbook integrations.
  + Develop dashboards, visual analytics, and decision‑support tools within Advana, leveraging PySpark, SQL, and platform‑native frameworks.
  + Ensure all analytics comply with DoD governance, security, and data‑management standards.

  + Build machine learning models to address forecasting, optimization, readiness assessments, and operational planning.
  + Visualize complex analytical findings in accessible, decision‑focused formats.
* **Data Engineering & Integration**
  + Ingest, clean, fuse, and normalize large structured and unstructured datasets from multiple DoD data sources.
  + Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, and platform‑specific tools.
  + Deploy automated workflows and CI/CD patterns for stable, repeatable analytics delivery.
* **Collaboration, Communication & Advisory Support**
  + Work closely with program managers, mission owners, analysts, engineers, and operators to identify analytical requirements.
  + Serve as a technical advisor to senior leaders on War Data Platform capabilities and analytic potential.
  + Translate complex data science outputs into clear, operationally meaningful insights.

**Skills and Qualification Required:**

* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Clearance eligibility required.
* Bachelor’s degree and 5–10+ years in data science, machine learning, data engineering, or advanced analytics.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to make sure our employees and their families have access to good health care, are insured against catastrophic health events, can put money aside for retirement and are able to maintain a healthy work-life balance. These benefits include:

jobs.title: Hardware Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission-critical, and that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux-based kiosks online, healthy, and self-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge.

You'll own everything from OS image management to over-the-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time.

### ***What You Will Do***

* Architect and implement OS-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks).
* Manage and enhance our OTA update framework to enable safe, atomic updates via A/B partition swapping and automated rollback when needed.
* Develop and maintain Python-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces.
* Own and maintain our custom Linux image (via Yocto, Buildroot, bootc, rpm-ostree, etc), managing systemd units, udev rules, and security policies for a locked-down, production-grade environment.
* Build lightweight monitoring agents to stream logs, metrics, and telemetry (connectivity, performance, temperature) to centralized observability systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Work closely with software, SRE, and field operations teams to identify pain points and develop scalable solutions that improve reliability and ease of maintenance.

### ***Who You Are***

* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering embedded Linux systems
* Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication.
* Familiarity with A/B update mechanisms (RAUC, Mender, SWUpdate, or custom partition-switching logic).
* Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS-232, USB-serial) and SDK-based hardware integration.
* Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration.
* Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale.
* Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices.

### ***Why You'll Love This Role***

* Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR's identity platform without disruption.
* Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering.
* End-to-end ownership**:** From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you'll own the full stack of machine reliability.
* Collaborative culture: Deep cross-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences.
* Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale.

### ***How You'll be Rewarded:***

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well-being and learning & development with stipends and reimbursement programs.

We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base compensation range for this role is **$90,000 – $135,000,** depending on levels of skills and experience.

This total compensation will include base salary and new hire equity package (in Restricted Stock Units) for this position at CLEAR. Additionally, this role will be eligible for refresh equity grants as part of our ongoing compensation program. Actual compensation will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, location, education, skills, experience, and performance. All stock based compensation will be subject to the terms and conditions of applicable agreements.

jobs.title: Cloud Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ANDECO:**

ANDECO Institute is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in McLean, Virginia. We serve as a vendor neutral intermediary between U.S. federal agencies and commercial data providers. We evaluate and score commercial data for government customers, and we take no ownership stakes in the vendors we assess. We are a small team, and each person here has a visible effect on what we deliver.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We are adding an engineer to own ANDECO's cloud environment for a federal data platform. A subcontractor will build most of the platform. You will hold the AWS accounts, control who has access, review the subcontractor's infrastructure code and security settings, and show that ANDECO can rebuild the platform from the source it receives. You will also support the APIs and services that serve data to users, and work with our data engineers on how data is stored and indexed.

You will work closely with ANDECO's data engineers and analysts, the application developers who build on the platform, and the subcontractor's engineers. Part of the job is translating between those groups and keeping the platform fast, secure, and easy to use.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Own the platform's AWS accounts, root credentials, and IAM structure, and give the subcontractor only the access its work needs.
* Review the subcontractor's infrastructure code, network design, and security configuration before deployment, and return anything that does not meet ANDECO requirements.
* Rebuild the platform in a clean account from delivered source and infrastructure code at agreed points, and report what fails.
* Track cloud spend against the plan and flag overruns early.
* Design and operate production APIs and services on AWS that serve platform data to users.
* Learn how the data engineering team governs its data, then design endpoints that are easy for end users to call and fast enough for heavy use.
* Support the application development team with API authentication, token lifecycle management, and end to end tracking of how users interact with the data.
* Monitor and enforce cloud security practices for the services you run, including IAM policy, network configuration, WAF rules, and data protection.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in production, and optimize latency, concurrency, and throughput while controlling costs.
* Collaborate with data engineers to improve how data is stored and indexed for API performance. When available, assist with data engineering work as the team needs support.
* Follow ANDECO processes and recommend improvements where they would help.
* Use ANDECO provided AI tools in your daily work.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* At least 4 years building and running production software in cloud environments, including at least 2 years on production APIs and 2 years on data engineering pipelines or frameworks.
* Python and SQL, plus the ability to pick up other languages as needed.
* Hands on AWS experience with Lambda and API Gateway, and with security services such as IAM, VPC configuration, WAF, and Shield.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, including reviewing code written by others.
* Experience querying and serving data from Databricks or a comparable distributed platform such as Redshift or Spark, with an understanding of data governance design.
* Experience securing APIs with standards such as OAuth2 and JWT, including token lifecycle management.
* Experience logging system health and user activity so that service quality and usage can be measured.
* Clear written and spoken communication, and experience working between engineering teams.
* Experience using AI tools in professional work, and willingness to adopt ANDECO provided AI tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. Employment is contingent on a successful pre-employment background check.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience reviewing or taking over cloud environments built by an outside vendor.
* Flask, FastAPI, or a similar Python web framework.
* Experience tuning APIs that stream or query large volumes of analytical data with low latency.
* Familiarity with AWS cost optimization.
* Experience handling sensitive or controlled data, such as PII, CUI, or data covered by NIST 800 series controls.

**BENEFITS:**

ANDECO offers paid time off, medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary life insurance, and a 403(b) retirement plan.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:**

ANDECO Institute is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

Pay: $130,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in McLean, VA 22102

Data Engineering provides the platform that enables Casper to efficiently produce, manage and consume high quality data.

* Build resilient ingestion pipelines from third-party platforms with idempotent loads so bad or partial loads never silently reach production tables.
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline performance bottlenecks and fine tuning workloads between raw to BI layer to prevent data outages.
* Set up monitoring and alerting across the pipeline to catch data anomalies before they compound.

* Dreaming of your next degree? After one year of service, we’ll help make that dream a little easier with tuition reimbursement.

You'll start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any issues from the previous night. From there, you might dive into a design discussion for an upcoming feature, pair with a teammate on a tricky implementation, or lead a code review session. Afternoons often involve collaborating with product managers to refine requirements or documenting your system's architecture for the broader team. You'll regularly identify opportunities to simplify and improve the software you work on.

Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the experience for Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, thoughtful engineering, and continuous learning. Every team member has a voice in shaping our technical direction, and we invest in each other's growth through mentorship and open dialogue. We're excited about the road ahead and are looking for engineers who want to make a lasting impact while growing alongside a supportive, inclusive team.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

You will be an Algorithm Engineer on the Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Sensor Fusion team, working at the forefront of sensor fusion, perception, and autonomy for fighter and unmanned platforms. In this role you will have a significant impact on shaping the future of Sensor Fusion across Aeronautics, defining the vision for our next‑generation platforms, and integrating Lockheed Martin’s most advanced technologies. If you thrive on pushing the envelope, enjoy tackling difficult algorithmic challenges, and are passionate about turning novel sensor concepts into flight‑ready software, this position on our Emerging‑Technology Sensor Fusion team is for you.

As an engineer working in sensor fusion you will possess a combination of skills from various disciplines:

**Programming Fundamentals**

Programming Languages: Proficiency in languages such as Python, C++, C#, or MATLAB.  
Software Frameworks: Familiarity with software frameworks, such as NumPy, SciPy, or TensorFlow, MATLAB, MATLAB Object Oriented, for numerical computations.  
Simulation Tools: Knowledge of simulation tools, such as Simulink or MATLAB, for modeling and testing sensor fusion systems.

**Mathematical Foundations**

Linear Algebra: Understanding of vector spaces, linear transformations, and matrix operations.  
Probability Theory and Statistics: Familiarity with probability distributions, Bayes' theorem, and stochastic processes. Knowledge of statistical inference, estimation, and hypothesis testing.  
Advanced topics: Understanding of numerical optimization, convex optimization, non-linear optimization, machine learning, and/or mathematical methods.

**Signal Processing and Filtering**

Signal Processing: Understanding of signal processing techniques, such as filtering, convolution, and Fourier analysis.  
Kalman Filter: Familiarity with the Kalman filter algorithm, its variants (e.g., Extended Kalman Filter, Unscented Kalman Filter), and applications.  
Particle Filter: Knowledge of particle filter algorithms and their applications in non-linear, non-Gaussian systems.

**Tracking**

Embedded Development: Acute proficiency in Programming Fundamentals applied to embedded systems.  
Sensor Modeling: Understanding of sensor characteristics, noise models, calibration techniques, Signal Processing and Filtering, and Mathematical Foundations.  
Data Association: Familiarity with data association techniques, such as nearest neighbor, joint probabilistic data association, and multiple hypothesis tracking.  
State Estimation: Knowledge of state estimation algorithms, including Kalman filters, particle filters, and Bayesian estimation methods.

**Sensor Integration and Management**

Resource Allocation: Experience tasking, prioritizing, and scheduling of sensors and maximizing information value, system needs, or target tracking accuracy with a deep understanding of Programming Fundamentals.  
Sensor Integration: Experience with integrating sensors like LIDAR, RADAR, or cameras and offboard sources.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

- Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

- Experience with C++, C#, Rust, MATLAB, and/or Python

- Real Time Operating System (RTOS) experience – (Windows & Linux)

- Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

**Desired Skills**
------------------

- Project experience in sensor fusion sub-domain(s) (e.g. state estimation, identification, correlation, sensor tasking) or coursework across domains including signal processing, artificial intelligence, autonomy/perception, artificial intelligence, navigation, or control systems in a sensor/systems application.

- Experience implementing Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or statistical algorithms in real time operating systems

- Strong understanding of Object Oriented Programming (OOP)/Object Oriented Design (OOD)

- Strong mathematical foundation in Linear Algebra, Probability Theory, and Statistics

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $67000.00 - $124400.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.
